defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses a Kruskal-style minimum spanning-tree approach instead of accounting for the possibility that noncritical repositories can serve as shared Steiner intermediaries.
Similarly applies ordinary Kruskal connectivity, effectively solving an MST/all-vertex connectivity problem rather than the minimum Steiner tree connecting only the critical repositories.

recommended_edit: Replace the bilateral/two-way agreement model with directed links whose direction is the listed u-to-v order, and require the critical repositories to satisfy the corresponding directed synchronization condition.
regression_risk: This could make the already-defeated MST-based models fail for additional reasons, but it should not restore either of them; it may also invalidate algorithms that correctly solve the original undirected Steiner-tree problem.
